content.text: Digital creators in regions like Nigeria, Ghana, and Kenya face significant challenges selling their products online due to restrictions from platforms like PayPal and Stripe. This limits access to essential tools for [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-every-detail-you-6|COREMERCH guide to payment]] processing and product delivery. Cloudflare R2 offers a solution, providing a powerful storage [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-3|The Full]] that allows creators to sell [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-sell-ebooks-kenya-step-step-deployment-guide-18|ebooks]], courses, and digital goods without relying on conventional payment systems. By leveraging this infrastructure, creators can establish a sovereign digital commerce stack that ensures reliable and cost-effective product delivery.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-3. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Cloudflare digital

Cloudflare R2 is an object storage service designed to handle large amounts of unstructured data, making it an ideal solution for digital product storage and delivery. Unlike traditional storage solutions that often come with high costs and limitations, R2 enables creators to host their files at minimal expense, with no egress fees for data retrieval. This is particularly important for digital creators who need to ensure their delivery processes remain efficient and economical. By utilizing R2, they can circumvent the high fees imposed by platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10% on every sale, allowing them to retain more of their income while providing a reliable service to their customers.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind Cloudflare R2 integrates seamlessly with other tools in the sovereign commerce stack. Creators can store their digital products in R2 while using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate the delivery process. When a customer makes a purchase, the payment is processed through NOWPayments, which charges only a 0.5% fee. This low-cost payment processing is complemented by R2's fast and reliable file delivery. The combination of these technologies ensures that creators can operate an efficient online store without the need for costly intermediaries. This architecture creates a strong foundation for digital sales, ensuring that creators maintain full control over their products and data.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are either unavailable or heavily restricted. Artists, educators, and entrepreneurs selling ebooks, courses, templates, and other digital products can benefit immensely from this setup. By using Cloudflare R2 in conjunction with NOWPayments, these creators can sell their products directly to customers around the world, ensuring they are not limited by geographical or economic barriers. This empowers them to build a sustainable income stream and grow their businesses without the fear of payment rejections or exorbitant fees.
Cloudflare R2 eliminates costly egress fees associated with traditional storage.
The Components That Make It Work Together

A fully operational sovereign digital commerce stack consists of several key components: Cloudflare R2 for storage, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for automation, NOWPayments for payment processing, and a reliable delivery mechanism for digital products. Each component serves a specific purpose, ensuring that the entire system operates smoothly. R2 acts as the backbone, storing digital assets securely, while Cloudflare Workers or Apps Script automates the order fulfillment process. NOWPayments enables instant crypto payments, allowing creators to receive funds quickly and securely. Together, these components create a cohesive, efficient system for selling digital products online.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start utilizing Cloudflare R2 for your digital product storage and delivery, follow these steps: First, sign up for a Cloudflare account and create an R2 bucket to store your digital files. Next, configure Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for automated delivery when a purchase is made. Integrate NOWPayments to handle crypto transactions without high fees. Finally, test the entire process to ensure that customers can purchase and receive their digital products smoothly. By following these steps, you can quickly deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack that aligns with your business needs.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
NOWPayments offers an unbeatable 0.5% fee compared to Gumroad's 10%.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I sell digital downloads without platform fees?
Utilize Cloudflare R2 for storage and NOWPayments for payment processing. This combination allows you to avoid platform fees while maintaining control over your sales and customer interactions.
Is it possible to use Cloudflare R2 for my ebooks?
Yes, Cloudflare R2 is an excellent solution for storing and delivering ebooks. It ensures your files are securely hosted and easily accessible for customers after purchase.
What types of digital products can I sell with this setup?
You can sell a variety of digital products, including ebooks, online courses, templates, fonts, and more, all through the sovereign commerce stack utilizing Cloudflare R2 and NOWPayments.
How does NOWPayments work for crypto transactions?
NOWPayments accepts over 300 cryptocurrencies and charges only a 0.5% fee for transactions. It processes payments automatically, integrating smoothly with your digital product delivery system.
Can I integrate this system with other tools?
Yes, you can integrate Cloudflare R2 and NOWPayments with various tools like Google Apps Script and Cloudflare Workers, ensuring flexibility in how you manage and automate your online sales.
